payload.title: File:Early archosauriform middle caudal vertebrae.jpg
payload.artist_html: Martín D. Ezcurra, Saswati Bandyopadhyay, Dhurjati P. Sengupta, Kasturi Sen, Andrey G. Sennikov, Roland B. Sookias, Sterling J. Nesbitt and Richard J. Butler
payload.description_html: Comparison between middle caudal vertebrae of selected Early and Middle Triassic non-eucrocopodan archosauriforms. (a) Erythrosuchus africanus (NHMUK PV R3592), (b, c) Chasmatosuchus rossicus (PIN 2252/383, (b) reversed), and (d, e) Sarmatosuchus otschevi (PIN 2865/68-25, holotype) in (a, b, d) lateral and (c, e) ventral views. gr, groove; ha, haemal arch; ns, neural spine; prz, prezygapophysis; tp, transverse process. Scale bars equal 5 mm.
